The structure of Tb4B4C2 (Tb2BC) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows B and C each coordinated by 5 Tb neighbors, while Tb has 9 geometric neighbors (4 B, 5 C). The neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 10 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner- and edge-sharing between Tb-centered 9-vertex polyhedra and between B- and C-centered 5-vertex polyhedra.
